what_this_asserts: punch_hole writes ONE byte of `coupling_hole`, a segment field_read never consults, so every rendered feature must be bit-identical before and after. This is BAR 4(d) asserted directly on every scored corner and every constructed probe -- including the holed conjunction itself, whose RENDER is unchanged even though the request is now refused. The refusal is a separate verb from the read, and that separation is what makes the hole a deletion rather than a distortion.
